text:
Alice Nguyen: Heads up — GreenField Labs (acct GF-0042) flagged a surprise dedicated burst charge on the July invoice. They say committed = 5,000 GPU-hours but they were billed for 12,400 burst hours. Can finance reconcile?

Raj Patel: Did they run an EU failover or DR test? That can push usage outside the committed region.

Alice Nguyen: They ran a DR test on 2026-07-12 (~02:00). Support marked it as expected, customer insists commit should have covered it (regional commit is US-WEST only).

Maya Singh: Pulling invoice INV-2026-07-423 now. Quick invoice snippet:
```
invoice_lines:
- committed_usw_hours: 5000
- burst_usw_hours: 7400
- committed_eu_hours: 0
- burst_eu_hours: 4000
- cross_region_failover_hours: 400
- total_burst_hours: 7800
```

Raj Patel: Those numbers don't add to 12,400. Looks like there might be double-counting during failover window.

Maya Singh: I see a meter duplication at 2026-07-12 02:00–02:15 where two router replicas emitted usage. Filing a credit request and opening CHG-7892 for full recon. Preliminary duplicate = ~25 GPU-hours.

Tom Lopez: Approve temporary hold on collection for this invoice. @Maya if estimated adjustment > $5k we'll need VP sign-off.

Maya Singh: Understood. Quick estimate: raw duplication * unit rate = ~$100. BUT the customer crossed their commit threshold so the platform applied the 'burst multiplier' for pricing tiers — that magnifies the billed amount. Need rate-card lookup.

Alice Nguyen: Customer is on 'Gold' reserved plan. Maya — can you confirm per-unit burst rate and multiplier so I can explain to client?

Maya Singh: Pulling rate card, will send calc by EOD and attach usage windows. CHG-7892 will include matched logs and meter traces.

Finance Bot: Invoice INV-2026-07-423 posted. To request manual adjustment run: `/billing adjust INV-2026-07-423 reason=commit-duplication amount=<estimate>`

Raj Patel: Suggest we pause autopay and flag the invoice as 'under review' in billing queue.

Tom Lopez: Done — invoice placed on hold. Maya, keep me posted. If reconciliation > 10% of monthly commit we may need SLA credit per section 4.2.

Maya Singh: Will do. Sending preliminary recon in CHG-7892 in ~3 hours.

Alice Nguyen: Thanks all — I'll tell GreenField we're investigating and have put their invoice on hold. Please Cc me on the adjustment ticket.
